title: Published coefficient 31/10 for the fixed BK/Shoup family

claims.statement: For the single total family defined in proof.md (the p=2 BK construction with one fixed deterministic Shoup field algorithm), L={x:f_|x|(x)=1} is in P and hence NP, and unconditionally C_B2(f_n)>=(31/10)n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer input length n=|x|, in the full Li–Yang B2 model.
